text:
marta: Heads-up — during the asia1 GPU scale-up window we saw controller-manager leader flips and a short spike of apiserver 5xx/503s starting ~02:12 UTC. Noticed via SRE dashboard.

alex: Seeing it too. apiserver request errors spiked, and controller-manager logs show lease renew failures + immediate re-elects.

diego: Any infra changes? We kicked off a large autoscaler job to add 40 GPU nodes at 02:00 for batch onboarding.

marta: Yes, autoscaler ramped fast. I suspect SNAT/conntrack exhaustion on the cloud NAT leading to ephemeral port reuse and dropped controlplane connections.

linda: Pulled logs from controller-manager: 
```
2026-03-05T02:13:04Z controller-manager: error getting leader lease: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
2026-03-05T02:13:05Z controller-manager: lost leader lease, initiating re-election
```

alex: kubectl top/controlplane shows CPU a little elevated but not saturated. However kube-proxy counters show conntrack table hits at ~98% and SNAT port usage extremely high.

diego: Can we get the NAT metrics?

ops-bot: cloud-nat: external-snat-asia1 usage=0.89 connections=72k peak_ephemeral_ports=28980 at=2026-03-05T02:14:10Z

linda: We also have apiserver logs with TLS EOFs to nodes: 
```
2026-03-05T02:13:12Z apiserver: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (client=10.2.5.60:43912)
2026-03-05T02:13:13Z apiserver: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
```

marta: SNAT exhaustion would cause new TCP connections from controlplane to nodes to fail or reset, which breaks leader lease renewals and watch streams. That would explain both controller-manager leader flips and apiserver 503s.

alex: Short-term mitigation options: 1) throttle autoscaler (pause scale-up) 2) add additional NAT IP(s) to pool 3) reduce churn by pausing daemonset restarts and onboarding jobs.

diego: Pause autoscaler now? We can delay node additions by 10m.

marta: Do it. Also request spare NAT IP allocation while we stabilize.

ops-bot: action=pause-autoscaler namespace=gpu-provision triggered_by=diego at=2026-03-05T02:16:02Z

alex: Paused. Applying NAT capacity request to cloud provider support. Raising SNAT pool now via infra control plane.

ops-bot: cloud-request: add_snat_ips count=2 region=asia1 requested_by=alex ticket=CP-7721 at=2026-03-05T02:17:30Z

linda: After pausing autoscaler, conntrack pressure dropped a bit, controller-manager leader stabilized (no flips in 8m) and apiserver 503s reduced. But watch churn remains elevated for a bit.

diego: Cost side: the failed watch reconnects triggered extra list operations while nodes were joining, estimated extra token-equivalent cost ~7k for asia1 during the 30m window.

marta: Follow-up actions: increase SNAT pool as permanent mitigation for large-scale onboarding; add autoscaler pacing limits for GPU pools; and add an alert for conntrack usage hitting 80%.

alex: Also let's instrument controller-manager lease renew latency and make a synthetic check that simulates NAT port pressure. Could save time on future scale-ups.

linda: Filed INFRA-4999: "asia1 SNAT/conntrack pressure -> controller-manager lease thrash during GPU scale-up" assigned to infra-net.

ops-bot: incident_log: created ticket=INFRA-4999 severity=medium owner=infra-net summary="SNAT exhaustion caused controlplane lease thrash during large GPU scale-up" at=2026-03-05T02:25:01Z

marta: Action items summary:
- diego: keep autoscaler paused until NAT IPs provisioned and verified.
- alex: follow up with cloud support and add SNAT IPs (CP-7721).
- linda: add conntrack usage alert and controller-manager lease latency synthetic.
- marta: schedule runbook update for GPU scale-ups (preflight SNAT check).

diego: I'll unpause after confirmation. PR queued to autoscaler config to add pacing limits.

alex: Post-change status: additional SNAT IPs applied, conntrack at ~45%, leader flips 0 in 20m, apiserver errors normal. Monitoring for 2 hours.

linda: Closing note: document included in INFRA-4999 with logs and cost estimate. Recommend 2 NAT IPs for future + autoscaler rate limit 5 nodes / 5m.

marta: Thanks team. Good call on pausing quickly.
